versions.name: Missouri River High Adventure Base

features.note: A 60-mile crew-led canoe trek down the Missouri River.
Built for older Scouts and high-adventure crews; no merit badge schedule.

versions.summary: High-adventure base offering a 60-mile canoe trek along the Missouri River, operated by Sioux Council in South Dakota.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). This is a trek base rather than a facility camp: the page states it has no cabins and no merit badge program, so the short feature list is the property, not a gap in sourcing.
